node.title: L1 fixed-syndrome multiprefix source and route cut
node.statement: For a monic degree-c polynomial fold with complete c-point fibers, fixing h partial fibers and r partial points and bucketing f full-fiber labels by t leading quotient coefficients gives one exact-boundary received word with at least ceil(binomial(|Q|-h,f)/|B|^t) codewords whenever 0<K<=A<=|D|, A=r+cf, and r+c(f-t-1)<K. Under upstream's printed complete-fold contract, the M31 (u,v)=(1,1) specialization has exact floor 1693898, refuting a universal per-profile cap 29. Independently, an F_17^* same-remainder pair has distinct actual agreement- and error-locator prefixes in both orientations. Hence an arbitrary-word fixed-syndrome count is a sum over attained prefixes; a maximum-prefix-fiber bound alone is insufficient without target coalescing/payment and first-match ownership. No L1 upper payment, M31 closure, or prize endpoint is asserted.
